patch_description: This crossover preserves the current program’s strongest elements: complete CZ pair coverage, symmetric parameter sharing, and two complementary CRZ bridges, which achieved the best validation accuracy and generalization. It adds the prior high-performing program’s shared noncommuting RX mixer, reusing the existing bridge parameter so the model gains an additional phase-to-population conversion path without increasing the parameter count. The result remains at four parameters per block and 26 total parameters, while aiming to retain the dual-bridge accuracy and improve optimization speed.
